description: Create the film's voice-over with the person's own ElevenLabs account (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on this machine), with the instant of each word, and put it in the film: made by an AI (the export says so), the music goes down under it. The words: text, else the voice prepared with set_voice, else the texts written in the film, one sentence per shot (examples left out). The voice: voice, else the one prepared, else the first ElevenLabs verified in the film's language (the answer names others). fit: true gives each shot its sentence's length; lead: "shots" keeps the shots' lengths and says again faster (up to 1.15×) a sentence too long for its shot. A voice already made whose sentences were rewritten (set_voice text, as many sentences) says again only those. One call costs the person's ElevenLabs credits (about one per character): say so before, and make it once the words are final.

fit.description: true: each shot takes its sentence's length (« Les plans suivent la voix »); false: the shots keep their lengths. Left out: as the prepared voice says, else false

lang.description: The language it is said in (fr, en…). Left out: the voice's, else the film's

lead.description: shots: « La voix suit les plans »: the shots keep their lengths, each sentence starts on its shot, and one too long for its shot is said again faster (up to 1.15×, its characters spent again); voice: as fit: true

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

start_shot.description: The shot it starts on. Left out: where it starts already, else the first

text.description: What the voice says: one sentence per shot, in order (a sentence ends on . ! ? … or a line break)

voice.description: The ElevenLabs voice: its id (and name), as the person's account lists it

name: make_voice
title: Create the voice-over with ElevenLabs
